exception.justification: Justified: This creates a borrowed session only; its operations observe their own requests.

review.item_premise: Public caller-owned admitted carriers and explicit unstable generation declarations, labelled judgements, references and immutable debit origins. Carrier construction and observation are outside the writer allowance. Only stored-state visits and requested reconstruction buffers are charged. No secret input, server session, second law, audit or public publication is enabled; the reader returns retained public evidence under the same request accounting.
